abstract: A product design agency plans, designs and tests digital products from strategy to release. Our team at ui-ux.agency, part of tkxel, covers user research, user experience (UX) design, user interface (UI) design, design systems and build support for web and mobile products, with projects from $25,000 and a senior designer on every engagement.

sections.h2: What does a product design agency do?
sections.answer: A product design agency decides what a product should do, how it should work and how it should look, then stays with the team until it ships. It joins strategy, research and design in one place.
sections.body: After the first release, a startup's product grows fast and unevenly. Features arrive from sales requests, investor feedback and the founders' own ideas. Without a product design partner, each feature looks and works a little differently. Our designers keep a single view of the whole product: who uses it, which jobs matter most and which screens need work next. Founders who still need a minimum viable product (MVP) start with our MVP design agency package.

sections.h2: What services does our product design agency cover?
sections.answer: Our product design agency covers 6 services in one team:

items.title: Product strategy.
items.body: Workshops that turn business goals into a clear product roadmap and design priorities.

items.title: User research.
items.body: Interviews, surveys and analytics reviews that show what users need and where they struggle.

items.title: UX design.
items.body: Information architecture, user flows and wireframes tested with real users.

items.title: UI design.
items.body: Final screens for web, iOS and Android with motion and accessibility built in.

items.title: Design systems.
items.body: Components, tokens and documentation shared by designers and engineers.

items.title: Build support.
items.body: Sprint reviews, design QA and quick answers while engineers build.

sections.h2: How does our product design agency plan the work?
sections.answer: Our product design agency plans the work in 4 stages, and each stage has a fixed scope and a clear output.

items.title: Discovery (1–3 weeks)
items.body: Stakeholder workshops, user interviews and a product audit that ends in a ranked list of problems.

items.title: Concept and validation (2–4 weeks)
items.body: Flows and prototypes for the top problems, tested with 5 to 8 users.

items.title: Detailed design (3–8 weeks)
items.body: Final screens, edge cases, empty states and the design system.

items.title: Delivery (ongoing)
items.body: Our designers stay in your sprints until the new design is live and measured.

sections.h2: Product design agency vs a UI design studio
sections.answer: A product design agency owns outcomes such as activation and retention; a UI design studio owns the look of the screens.

sections.h2: Why startups choose our product design agency
sections.answer: Startups choose our product design agency for 4 reasons.

items.title: Senior people only
items.body: Every project is led by a senior product designer who stays from discovery to release.

items.title: Design and engineering in one company
items.body: As part of tkxel, our designers work next to engineers who build what we design.

items.title: Built for SaaS and AI
items.body: Deep pattern knowledge from our SaaS design agency and AI work.

items.title: Flexible models
items.body: Fixed-scope projects or a monthly team that grows and shrinks with your roadmap.

sections.h2: How much does a product design agency cost?
sections.answer: Product design with our agency costs $25,000 to $180,000 per project, or $15,000 to $40,000 per month for an embedded team.
sections.body: A discovery and concept phase for one product area sits near $25,000. A full product with a design system, web and mobile apps and build support sits near $180,000. Teams that want designers inside their sprints instead of a fixed project can hire UI UX designers monthly. Every cost factor is explained in the UI UX design cost guide.

sections.answer: Answers to common questions about working with a product design agency.

faqs.q: Does your product design agency also build the product?
faqs.a: Yes. ui-ux.agency is the design team of tkxel, a software engineering company, so design and development run in one contract when you need both.

faqs.q: How quickly can a product design project start?
faqs.a: Most projects start within 1 to 2 weeks of a signed proposal.

faqs.q: Which tools does your product design team use?
faqs.a: Figma for design and prototypes, FigJam for workshops, Maze for remote tests and Storybook for design system documentation.

faqs.q: Can you work with our in-house designers?
faqs.a: Yes. We often lead research and the design system while in-house designers own day-to-day feature work.
